sentences.en: This language has few cases, but they are very irregular.
sentences.zh: 这种语言几乎没有格的变化，但它们非常不规则。

sentences.en: She could construe irregular Latin verbs without a moment's hesitation.
sentences.zh: 她可以毫不犹豫地推断出不定式动词的词形变化。

sentences.en: The prices of tomatoes are very irregular throughout the year.
sentences.zh: 整年西红柿的价格都非常不稳定。

senses.zh: 不整齐的；不规则的；不正常的；非正规的；不按时的；便秘的（委婉语）
不规则物；不合规格的产品；非正规军人员
